t: Turning towards Him at the start
a: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
p: Innī wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhī faṭara-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍa ḥanīfan wa mā ana mina-l-mushrikīn.
m: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
